mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bookmark_practice WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bookmark_id = #{bookmarkId} ORDER BY practice_id DESC

SELECT bp.*, bd.question_text, bd.difficulty, bd.keyword_tags FROM bookmark_practice bp JOIN battle_bookmark bb ON bp.bookmark_id = bb.bookmark_id JOIN battle_detail bd ON bb.ref_battle_id = bd.battle_id AND bb.ref_detail_id = bd.detail_id WHERE bp.user_id = #{userId} AND bp.practice_id = #{practiceId}
